company.name: Fat Burners Only
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Protein bars (Snickers, Mars, ATP Science, EHP Labs, Maxine's, PhD, BSc, Veego, Smart Diet Solutions), vegan snacks, protein custard desserts and supplements
company.channels_supplied: Its own online shop with delivery across Australia and click and collect in Perth
company.sf_brands_carried: Low sugar protein bars from Smart Diet Solutions, PhD Smart Bar, Maxine's and BSc; none is a direct sugar-free confectionery competitor
what_they_do_well: Customer reviews on its own bars page praise fast next-day delivery and handwritten notes in orders.
company.fit_rationale: A Perth online sports nutrition retailer whose own website has a protein bars category with about a dozen other brands, including Mars and Snickers protein bars, plus a vegan snacks section. Its weight-conscious shoppers are a close match for Diablo's no-added-sugar bars, chocolate and cookies. Store count is not stated on its website.

company.name: Gifts on the Gold Coast
company.distributes: Gift hampers and baskets with branded chocolate (Lindt, Ferrero Rocher, Whittaker's, Cadbury, Toblerone), sweets and gummies (Haribo, The Natural Confectionery Co, Darrell Lea, Skittles), cookies and biscuits (Byron Bay Cookies, MallowPuffs) and snacks
company.channels_supplied: Online shop with free same-day delivery across the Gold Coast; corporate gift orders
what_they_do_well: Offers free same-day hamper delivery across the Gold Coast, seven days a week, naming suburbs from Surfers Paradise to Coomera.
company.fit_rationale: Locally owned Gold Coast hamper company whose product pages list many other brands' chocolate, lollies, cookies and snacks, including non-alcoholic sweet hampers for corporate and personal gifting. It already uses a sugar-free drinking chocolate, so Diablo chocolate, gummies and cookies would fit its sweet hampers. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Ginger B
company.distributes: Gourmet gift hampers with chocolate from other brands (Bahen & Co, Chocolate Grove, Great Southern Truffles, Nougat & Nice, Charlotte Piper rocky road) and savoury snacks (Duck Creek macadamias, crackers and nuts)
company.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers and corporate clients (automotive, finance, legal, health, real estate) online with same-day Perth metro delivery and Australia-wide shipping
what_they_do_well: Delivering local gift hampers in Perth since 2011, with a dedicated corporate gifting service by industry.
company.fit_rationale: Perth gift hamper retailer with 39 gourmet hampers built around chocolate and confectionery brands from other producers, plus gluten free and alcohol free ranges. Its corporate gifting and chocolate boxes are a natural home for Diablo's chocolate boxes and pralines; no sugar-free range is shown.

company.name: My Ride
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Bikes and cycling gear with a nutrition and hydration section: energy bars (SiS Go Energy Mini Bar and Energy Bake bar), energy chews (gummies) and energy gels from SiS, Pure and GU.
company.channels_supplied: Over 20 independently owned specialist bike stores nationwide, including My Ride Unley in Adelaide, plus its own online shop.
what_they_do_well: Describes itself as Australia's largest network of independently owned specialist cycling stores, with over 20 stores nationwide.
My Ride Unley absorbed the Woodville store's operations and is now the only bike store left in Unley.
company.fit_rationale: A national network of specialist cycling stores with an Adelaide store at Unley that already sells energy bars and chews from other brands to active, health-conscious shoppers. Diablo's no-added-sugar muesli and cereal bars and gummies suit the same counter. Head office city not stated on its website.

company.name: Nosh Gourmet Food & Gifts
company.distributes: Gift hampers with chocolate (Nakamura Chocolates, Gabriel Chocolate), biscuits (Simply Beautiful Biscuits, The Tea Cookie Co.), fudge, nougat and toffees (Chaos Fudge, The Toffee Factory, Mondo Nougat) and savoury snacks
company.channels_supplied: Corporate gifting clients, its East Victoria Park store and online shop, delivery across Perth and Australia
what_they_do_well: Creating luxury gift hampers in Perth since 2011, with personalised corporate gifting and Australia-wide delivery.
Publishes a supplier list of over 40 Western Australian producers it stocks.
company.fit_rationale: Perth hamper house specialising in personalised corporate gifting, built on chocolate, biscuits and sweets from more than 40 named WA suppliers. A sister business, Small Batch Workshop Co, supplies part of its chocolate, but most lines are other companies' brands. Storage: sells from its own stock and store, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Onsite Vending
company.distributes: Chocolate bars, chips, protein bars, low-calorie and high-protein snacks, noodle cups, shakes and drinks in vending machines
company.channels_supplied: Vending machines on construction sites, offices, warehouses, shopfronts and gyms across Adelaide and South Australia
company.sf_brands_carried: Protein bars, low-calorie and high-protein snacks; no sugar-free brand named and no direct competitor seen
what_they_do_well: Specialises in construction site vending across South Australia, with machines remotely monitored 24/7 to keep stock full.
company.fit_rationale: South Australian operator that stocks its machines with chocolate bars, protein bars and low-calorie snacks, so Diablo's sugar-free chocolate and bars match both its classic and healthy ranges. Its focus on construction sites and gyms gives fewer but busy selling points. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Pencraft Office National
company.distributes: Canteen and kitchen range with biscuits and snacks plus confectionery and chocolate: Mentos, Allens Minties and Snakes Alive, Lotus Biscoff, Arnott's
company.channels_supplied: Brisbane offices and businesses through its own web shop and delivery
what_they_do_well: Lists more than 1,200 canteen and kitchen lines, including Allens, Mentos, Lotus Biscoff and Arnott's portion packs.
company.fit_rationale: Australian-owned Brisbane office supplier in the Office National group with its own Biscuits and Snacks and Confectionery and Chocolate categories, selling branded sweets and biscuits to local offices. Storage: B2B web shop with stock and prices, run from Fortitude Valley; warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Ripe n Raw Organics
company.distributes: Organic groceries with chocolate and confectionery, cookies and biscuits, spreads and jams, chips and crackers, alongside fresh produce
company.channels_supplied: Its own online shop with home delivery across wider Brisbane, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Toowoomba and Northern NSW, plus a stall at the Davies Park Market in West End
what_they_do_well: Trading since 2003, growing from a West End market stall into home delivery from a large Rocklea warehouse.
company.fit_rationale: A Brisbane organic home delivery grocer whose pantry has its own chocolate and confectionery, cookies and biscuits and spreads and jams sections, selling brands such as Green Grove Organics. It reaches health-conscious households across South East Queensland, a good fit for Diablo's vegan spreads, jams and biscuits.

company.name: Scorpion Vending
company.distributes: Chocolate bars (Cadbury, Kit Kat, Snickers, Mars, Twix, Maltesers), sweets (Allen's lollies, chewing gum), cookies (Biscoff, Future Bake), protein bars (Clif), chips and drinks in snack and combination vending machines
company.channels_supplied: Workplace vending machines across Perth, snack-only, drink-only or combination
company.sf_brands_carried: Clif protein bars, vege chips and soy crisps; no direct sugar-free confectionery competitor named
what_they_do_well: Restocks high-volume workplace sites up to twice weekly, at no cost to the host business.
company.fit_rationale: A family-run Perth operator whose machines already carry branded chocolate, lollies, cookies and bars from other companies, which covers four of Diablo's categories. It customises selections on request, so a sugar-free chocolate bar or cookie suits its workplace sites. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Shindigs
company.based_out_of: Australia, head office not stated on its website
company.distributes: Party and seasonal confectionery: chocolate, gummies and jelly sweets, hard candy, jelly beans, lollipops, marshmallows, American candy and savoury snacks, including Allens lollies and a Halloween confectionery range
company.channels_supplied: Its own online party supplies shop, shipping to shoppers across Australia including Brisbane
what_they_do_well: Runs a dedicated Halloween confectionery and candy buffet range alongside its party supplies.
Claims more than 750,000 customers and 18,000 products on its online shop.
company.fit_rationale: A national online party and seasonal retailer with a deep lollies department of branded sweets and a dedicated Halloween confectionery range, which suits Diablo's gift boxes, gummies and chocolate for party and seasonal occasions. Its site claims more than 750,000 customers and 18,000 products. No sugar free shelf was seen, which leaves room for Diablo.

company.name: Smart Vending
company.distributes: Chocolate bars (Cadbury, Kit Kat, Snickers, Twirl, M&M's), chips and savoury snacks (Smith's, Kettle, Cheezels, Thins) and drinks in snack, drink and combo vending machines
company.channels_supplied: Offices, hotels, industrial sites, government, manufacturing and engineering sites, call centres and university campuses in Perth
what_they_do_well: Serves offices, hotels, government, industrial and university campus sites across Perth, with restocking and maintenance included.
company.fit_rationale: A Perth free-vending operator, established in 2020, that stocks well known and new-to-market snack brands from other companies, led by branded chocolate bars. Diablo's chocolate bars and wafers suit its office and campus machines. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: St Anne's Florist & Gift Baskets
company.distributes: Gift hampers and chocolate and lolly hampers with Cadbury chocolate, Smarties, Perugina chocolate, The Natural Confectionery Co lollies, Margaret River Fudge Factory fudge and Smiths chips, plus chocolate bouquets and Easter and Christmas gifts
company.channels_supplied: Its Newcastle Street shop in Perth and online, delivering across Perth metro, WA, Australia and internationally
what_they_do_well: Has delivered hampers, gift baskets and gifts across Perth since 1970.
company.fit_rationale: Long-running Perth gift basket and hamper shop whose chocolate and lolly hampers are filled with other companies' branded chocolate, lollies and snacks, with seasonal Easter and Christmas ranges. Flowers are also a large part of the business, but hampers and gift baskets are a core category with many branded sweets lines.

company.name: Vending Trends
company.distributes: Chocolate (Cadbury, Mars), muesli and snack bars (Carman's), savoury snacks (Sam Boy, cheese and crackers) and drinks in snack and drink vending machines
company.channels_supplied: Snack and drink vending machines in businesses across the Perth metro area
company.sf_brands_carried: Carman's (better-for-you bars); no direct competitor named
what_they_do_well: Family-owned Perth operator covering delivery, installation, stock, restocking and repairs at no charge to host businesses.
company.fit_rationale: A local, family-owned Perth vending supplier that stocks branded chocolate and Carman's bars from other companies, so Diablo's chocolate bars and muesli bars fit its machines. It supplies the initial stock and restocks machines itself. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Williams & Taylor Artisan Hampers
company.distributes: Hampers with branded chocolate (Chocolate at No. 5), nougat (Noogaa), shortbread biscuits (Frantic Whisk), fruit cake (Baylies), jams (Fiaje), nuts, olives and wine
company.channels_supplied: Its own online shop and corporate hampers for client and staff gifting, hand delivered in Adelaide and shipped interstate
what_they_do_well: Corporate programme from five hampers with 10% off, free branded cards and inserts, and owner hand delivery in Adelaide.
Builds hampers from small-batch Adelaide Hills and Fleurieu producers, featured by Glam Adelaide.
company.fit_rationale: Adelaide Hills hamper business that buys chocolate, nougat, biscuits, cakes and jams from independent producers and resells them in corporate hampers. Corporate orders start at five hampers with custom branding, giving Diablo a route into business gifting in Adelaide. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
